result.stdout:
Description:
  Piston — continuous test runner for .NET

Usage:
  piston [<solution>] [command] [options]

Arguments:
  <solution>  Path to the .sln, .slnx, or .slnf file. Defaults to .piston.json's solution, then a unique solution in the current directory.

Options:
  --pipe-name <pipe-name>  Override the named pipe name (default: auto-generated from solution path).
  --web-port <web-port>    Port for the web UI and WebSocket server. [default: 5199]
  -?, -h, --help           Show help and usage information
  --version                Show version information

Commands:
  daemon <solution>           Start the Piston daemon in the foreground.
  mcp <solution>              Serve the Piston MCP tools over stdio for one agent session (cwd = worktree). Runs an in-process engine (startup run, then runs on file changes) and exits with the session.
  dashboard <solution>        Inspect the current worktree's dashboard without starting Piston.
  stop <solution>             Stop the running Piston daemon.
  status <solution>           Show the status of the running Piston daemon.
  trust <path>                Trust or revoke a repository clone for builds and tests.
  coverage-export <solution>  Export the running daemon's coverage report as LCOV or Cobertura XML.
  init                        Print or (with --write) install Piston's agent integration assets. Never changes configuration without --write.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Start the Piston daemon in the foreground.

Usage:
  piston [<solution>] daemon [<solution>] [options]

Arguments:
  <solution>  Path to the .sln, .slnx, or .slnf file. Defaults to .piston.json's solution, then a unique solution in the current directory.

Options:
  --debounce <debounce>        File-change debounce interval in milliseconds. [default: 0]
  --filter <filter>            Substring or regex to filter test names on startup.
  --coverage                   Enable code coverage collection (default: on), overriding .piston.json.
  --no-coverage                Disable code coverage collection, overriding .piston.json.
  --parallelism <parallelism>  Maximum number of concurrent dotnet test processes. 0 = auto. [default: 0]
  --stdio                      Use stdin/stdout for Piston JSON-RPC transport (not MCP).
  --no-stdio                   Use named-pipe transport, overriding the .piston.json stdio setting.
  --pipe-name <pipe-name>      Override the named pipe name (default: auto-generated from solution path).
  --mcp-port <mcp-port>        Port for the MCP server (default: 5200, or mcpPort in .piston.json).
  --web-port <web-port>        Port for the web UI and WebSocket server. [default: 5199]
  -?, -h, --help               Show help and usage information

Description:
  GitHub Copilot: the MCP server entry, the `piston` skill and the Piston dashboard canvas.

Usage:
  piston [<solution>] init copilot [options]

Arguments:
  <solution>  Path to the .sln, .slnx, or .slnf file. Defaults to .piston.json's solution, then a unique solution in the current directory.

Options:
  --write              Write the assets. Without it, only report what would change; nothing is written.
  --scope <repo|user>  user: the harness's user configuration directory. repo: the current directory (the repository root). [default: user]
  --force              With --write, overwrite Piston's MCP entry and asset files when their content differs.
  -?, -h, --help       Show help and usage information
